label: RECORDED TESTNET RUN — real transactions on NEAR testnet, not sample data
runs: npm run demo -- --bounties procurement,starter (bounties #4 procurement, #5 starter glossary)

files.offchain/<sha256>.json: content-addressed objects (spec, deliverable, report, selection); file bytes = canonical JSON, sha256(bytes) = file name = the on-chain hash
files.index.jsonl: one line per stored object: {hash, kind, bounty_id, round, actor, ts}
files.strategy/<worker>.jsonl: adaptive worker strategy changes: {ts_ms, worker, bounty_id, old_margin, new_margin, reason, window}
files.tx.jsonl: every agent transaction: {ts, actor, contract, method, args, txHash, ok, explorer}
files.chain-state.json: snapshot of all hub/token views taken after the run (same shape as data/sample/chain-state.json)
